answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 46163 Country: India Title: Dua or quranic ayat for protection from eneymies Question: Please give me dua or ayat from Quran to blow on water spray all corner of my house to protect me and my family and house from enemies and poisonous animals. Answer ID: 46163 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1211/1004/H=10/1434) Recite the following dua 120 times with durood 3-3 times before and after and blow on water and sprinkle it in the corners and walls of the house. إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْداً وَأَكِيدُ كَيْداً فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْداً Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
